answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot within a strictly audited terrace of active node clusters. An honest agent pays for its unique reservation, while 1,000 fakes must forge parallel requests, incurring immense costs that mirror the difficulty of hardware scaling. A verifier checks the occupancy of these slots, rejecting any fable of activity that lacks a confirmed signal, with lapses triggering immediate identity revocation.
